integrity: An exact analytic stochastic sandwich is proved. A separately executable exact-switch-clock calculation checks finite cases and compares an independent published mean formula; it does not establish an infinite-parameter theorem by enumeration. Scientific priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric athermal two-velocity harmonic run-and-tumble model; fair initial orientation; finite-distance bounds for launch parameter C>=1; first entry into the compact stationary position support, not first passage to the origin. No biased switching, translational diffusion, nonlinear trap or joint-parameter limit is asserted.
title: A quantitative log-Beta law for harmonic run-and-tumble trapping times
